custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, and an active part, part B, both with stock.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 6.6 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Create Return page (Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then start a new return).

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839492 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839492-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  2. Set part A inactive: On the Inventory page click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839492-A. Click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
  3. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839492 PART B; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839492-B; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  4. The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839492-.
